title: Search a list recursively
description: You can follow contains? as it examines one list element per call.

steps.description: contains? accepts a target x and a list l. The empty-list branch returns #f.
A matching head returns #t. Otherwise the next call searches the tail with the same target.

steps.question: Which supplied target appears in the list?
steps.answer: 3 appears and returns #t. 9 is absent and returns #f.

steps.description: The two displayed results are #t and #f. Each recursive call keeps the target and shortens the list.
